Importing Legacy .CHM, .HHP, WinHelp .HLP & .CNT Files

Millions of desktop, CAD, laboratory, and industrial Windows applications still rely on 1990s help formats that break on Windows 11. RaggieSoft Help Studio rescues both generations natively in pure C++20 without calling hh.exe, itss.dll, or retired WinHlp32.exe.

Raw .CHM (ITSF / LZX) & .HHP Decompiler

  • Extracts ITSF v3 containers and decompresses LZX sliding-window streams directly—eliminating corporate \\fileserver\share UNC and Mark-of-the-Web blank screens.
  • Parses .hhc Table of Contents and .hhk Index <OBJECT type="text/sitemap"> hierarchies even when legacy SGML omits closing </LI> tags.
  • Recovers binary #IVB and [MAP] numeric F1 Context IDs (0x1040) automatically.

Classic WinHelp .HLP + .CNT & Word .RTF Rescue

  • Decodes 3F 5F 03 00 internal B+ tree directories, |SYSTEM metadata, LZ77-compressed |TOPIC paragraphs, |CONTEXT hash tables, and |KWBTREE index keywords.
  • Automatically pairs sibling .hlp and .cnt files in the same folder, or imports .hpj + Microsoft Word footnote-coded .rtf (#, $, K) sources.
  • Scrubs Microsoft Word MsoNormal, <o:p>, <font color="black">, and FrontPage inline styles so rescued topics render with crisp contrast in Windows 11 Dark Mode and High Contrast.
